title: Composite-circuit manifest (plan_hierarchical_composition §5.2, P4-1)
description: AUTHORED at circuits/<id>/composition.yaml. Declares the instance DAG a composite is flattened from: which registry block, pinned topology version, block-port→parent-net map, optional taps (parent net onto a block-internal node) + omit (block device cards the parent wiring replaces — the D3 instantiator-owns-bias seam), and parent-owned sizing overrides. `analog-db generate` composes abstract/netlist.spice (flat, self-contained) + pdk/<pdk>/sizing.yaml from it; both are GENERATED + drift-guarded.

of.description: The composite circuit id — must equal circuit.yaml's id.

notes.description: Authored prose emitted into the generated netlist header (design intent, sign conventions, deviations).

name.description: Parent-unique instance name. Devices get the _<NAME-uppercased> suffix, internal nets the <name>__ prefix, free knobs the _<name> suffix.

block.description: A registry circuit id (the block being instantiated).

pin.description: Pinned block topology version: sha256 of the block's committed abstract/topology.cgraph.json, first 12 hex chars. The compose:pins validator fails on mismatch (bump deliberately after a block change).

ports.description: block port → parent net. Keys must be EXACTLY the block's circuit.yaml ports.

taps.description: block-INTERNAL net → parent net (exposes an internal node to parent wiring, e.g. a bias node a servo drives). Key must name a non-port net of the block netlist.

omit.description: Block device cards to DROP (exact netlist names), e.g. the internal knob source a tapped parent connection replaces.

override.description: Parent-owned sizing edits: block-LOCAL sizing symbol → new default (applied to every bound PDK's materialized sizing).

nets.description: Composite-owned raw SPICE cards appended verbatim (coupling caps, reference sources, …). Their free symbols live in the parent namespace (declare knobs under sizing.variables).

variables.description: Composite-owned sizing variable rows (sizing@1 variable shape) appended to every generated pdk/<pdk>/sizing.yaml.
